opportunities.point: Management aims to achieve 25% to 30% annual top-line growth by 2030.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Locations have been finalized for upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur and Dahod with development progressing.

opportunities.point: The company expanded its retail footprint in Central India by inaugurating a new store in Dhar, taking total store count to 12.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new s in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12." opportunities.point: P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.

opportunities.point: The company plans to expand in Tier 2 and 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat and Maharashtra in the upcoming 5 years.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: Management guides for EBITDA margin of around 6% to 6.5% for FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [FY27]

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Borrowings above equity leave limited room if the cycle turns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.

threats.evidence: DCF intrinsic 409 vs price 1,462 - margin of safety -258%

threats.point: The price demands a very high growth rate to be justified.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Volatile and elevated gold prices in FY26 impacted consumer affordability and muted volume growth.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Throughout FY26, gold prices were on an upward trajectory and quite volatile, which impacted affordability and consumer buying patterns. As a result, while value growth remained strong, volume growth was relatively muted." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Recent statements by the Prime Minister created a slight short-term sentiment impact on demand.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "See, the Prime Minister’s statement may have a slight short-term impact on sentiment, but overall, we believe the underlying demand for gold remains strong." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Management noted that elevated gold prices and broader industry challenges impacted demand volumes.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Despite elevated gold prices and broader industry challenges impacting demand volumes, the Company demonstrated remarkable resilience, delivering steady revenue growth supported by robust customer footfalls, strong conversion rates, and deep-rooted brand..." (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Jun) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: No quadrant dominates - weaknesses, opportunities carry equal weight (S26/W28/O28/T22), so the evidence does not favour one side.
